user.description: Add a media player to a speaker already discovered by the MQTT integration. Existing entities remain unchanged.

data_description.device_id: The 12 hexadecimal characters returned by GET /api/device/id, for example F88B419FC114. Not the Home Assistant device registry ID.
data_description.power_entity: Select the existing MQTT radio power switch for this speaker.
data_description.topic_prefix: The base topic configured in the speaker, for example esp32radio-419FC114. Do not include /set or /state.

reconfigure.description: Update the MQTT prefix and refresh entity mappings for the same physical speaker.

data_description.device_id: Keep the same firmware device ID used during setup.
data_description.power_entity: Select the current MQTT radio power switch for this speaker.
data_description.topic_prefix: The current MQTT base topic configured in the speaker.

error.device_mismatch: The switch, firmware ID and MQTT prefix do not match. Select the radio power switch and check the speaker settings.
error.invalid_device_id: Enter the 12 hexadecimal characters returned by /api/device/id.
error.invalid_topic: Enter a non-empty MQTT base topic without wildcard characters.
error.missing_entities: The MQTT power and volume entities must exist and be enabled. Check MQTT discovery first.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This is a different physical speaker. Add it as a separate helper instead.

invalid_media.message: Provide an HTTP(S) audio URL, a Home Assistant media source, or an available SD file path.

invalid_source.message: Select a source from the current radio and SD source list.

invalid_volume.message: Volume must be a number between 0 and 1.
